title: Legends and the arena in town
text:
Legendary weapons glow, Varro recruits for the arena from Hearthmere, and phones get their own install button.

✨ Legendary weapons glow softly in your hand with sparks in their colour, so everyone can see you carry one
✨ A legendary weapon adds a glowing buff icon under your portrait showing its power, for example Cinderheart, Focus of the Wyrm: +10% spell damage. Every class has its own
⬆️ Varro the Bloodsworn now stands in the south square of Hearthmere with war banners, a weapon rack and a training dummy. The big stone gate out in the wilds is gone, and leaving the arena brings you back to him
✨ The start screen has an iPhone · iPad · Android button next to Windows, Mac and Linux, with simple steps to install the game on your home screen (on Android it can install straight away)
🔧 Class names on the character screen, such as Shade, are centred
